decisions.name: Premise Explored as Sincere Inquiry
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether the premise is genuinely explored vs used only to set up a joke.

decisions.name: Concrete sensory specificity
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether concrete detail makes scenes vivid/particular, not mere presence of nouns.

decisions.name: Psychological Contradiction
decisions.audit_reason: Rewards meaningful internal character conflict over flat, uniform reactions — characterization depth.

decisions.name: Reframing Reveal
decisions.audit_reason: Assesses whether the twist meaningfully recontextualizes earlier content — craft of structure.

decisions.name: Form enacts the condition it describes
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether form enacts content, a canonical literary craft technique, not decorative formatting alone.

decisions.name: Tonal Control Across Shifts
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether tonal control/shifts are deliberately staged vs accidental — a craft skill, not surface form.

decisions.name: A speaking presence, judged separately from clean mechanics
decisions.audit_reason: Detects an individual vs institutional/procedural presence behind the prose — an authorship fingerprint, not judged craft.

decisions.name: Substantive Completion
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether the ending delivers developed consequence vs mere setup — core craft judgment.

decisions.name: Interpretive Work Left to the Reader
decisions.audit_reason: Rewards implication/show-don't-tell over stated exposition — classic craft criterion.

decisions.name: Implied worldbuilding
decisions.audit_reason: Rewards dramatized, implied worldbuilding over direct exposition — craft judgment.

decisions.name: Embodied nonhuman perspective
decisions.audit_reason: Judges consistency/depth of nonhuman POV execution, a genuine craft dimension.

decisions.name: Sustained in-world idiolect in the narration
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether narration sustains a self-consistent invented conceptual vocabulary — worldbuilding craft, not just naming.

decisions.name: Causal escalation
decisions.audit_reason: Rewards causal, escalating plot logic over piled-on or summarized events — structural craft.

decisions.name: Narrative Economy
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether content is padded vs purposeful — editorial tightness is a quality criterion.

decisions.name: Non-obvious interpretive angle
decisions.audit_reason: Rewards originality of interpretive angle over the obvious/default reading — creative merit.

decisions.name: Sign-off naming a personal subreddit or author handle
decisions.audit_reason: Detects author handle/subreddit sign-off; instruction explicitly says do not weigh story quality.

decisions.name: Editorial provenance
decisions.audit_reason: Named 'editorial provenance': detects signs of post-draft production/polish, not story quality itself.

decisions.name: Event-format compliance
decisions.audit_reason: Scores visible platform/event furniture (tags, moderator notices) rather than story content.

decisions.name: Direct name-check of recognizable franchise/pop-culture figures
decisions.audit_reason: Flags borrowed franchise characters by presence only; explicitly not judged on how well handled.

decisions.name: Stock genre furniture: aliens, HFY, isekai, dragons, capes
decisions.audit_reason: Counts stock genre props/fashionable tropes; explicitly does not judge how well handled.

decisions.name: Explicit meta-reference to writing speed or chain handoff
decisions.audit_reason: Flags meta-reference to production speed or chain handoff — provenance/timing fingerprint, not content quality.

decisions.name: Appended author note, thanks, or request for feedback
decisions.audit_reason: Counts reader-facing addenda (thanks, A/N, experience disclosure) — platform/author-fingerprint furniture.

decisions.name: Fragmented lineation
decisions.audit_reason: Counts presence of fragmented formatting/short lines without judging whether the choice is effective.

decisions.name: Concrete-noun token count
decisions.audit_reason: Pure count of concrete nouns; instruction explicitly ignores whether detail is well chosen.

decisions.name: Question-mark count
decisions.audit_reason: Pure punctuation count, explicitly ignoring content or open-endedness.
